resource_budget.output_bound_note: Aggregate counters and one row per cell; no per-instance stream.

panel.degree_cells_note: [8,4,2] is deliberate: l = 2 < m - 1 = 3, the regime where the degree law must cap at m*l rather than m(m-1). It is the cell that corrected the law.
panel.ladder_note: l = ceil(n/m) on every rung, so the descended variable count tracks n and the fit is against a moving system of the same shape. Cells exceeding the timeout are recorded censored and EXCLUDED from every fit.
panel.ladder_timeout_note: 300 s per cell per target. Set during design, before any run of this plan was archived; no committed run used a different value. A cell exceeding it is recorded censored and excluded from every fit.

preregistered_predictions.statement: Charging sparse linear algebra against rho forces the factor-base dimension below roughly n/4 + log_q(R)/2; combined with needing decompositions to exist at all, no m <= 3 cell has a positive per-decomposition budget at any of the nine target degrees UNLESS the Frobenius orbit quotient is available, and where it is the m = 3 budget is under 10 bits.
preregistered_predictions.falsified_if: an m <= 3 cell shows a budget above 10 bits at any target degree

preregistered_predictions.statement: m = 2 has a NEGATIVE budget at every target degree, by at least 20 bits: it loses to rho even if every decomposition were free.
preregistered_predictions.falsified_if: any target degree admits a non-negative m = 2 budget

preregistered_predictions.statement: The measured Boolean degree of the Weil-descended system equals m * min(m-1, l) on every degree cell.
preregistered_predictions.falsified_if: any cell's measured degree differs from that

preregistered_predictions.statement: The descended ANF is DENSE: its distinct-monomial count is at least 1/8 of the dense bound sum_{i<=D} C(m l, i) on every degree cell, so that bound is tight to within three bits and is a fair proxy for the cost of forming the system.

At the target degrees the ANF size EXCEEDS the whole per-decomposition budget for n <= 283 and falls BELOW it at n = 409 and n = 571, so the obstruction below the crossover is the size of the system rather than the difficulty of solving it.
preregistered_predictions.falsified_if: the ANF fits the budget at any n <= 283, or fails to fit at 409 or 571, at the best arity

preregistered_predictions.statement: The measured Groebner solve-time exponent in descended variables at m = 2 is between 0.45 and 0.70, consistent with the independent per-PDP slope 0.5581 [0.5359, 0.5805] recorded by EV-ICI-001 on the same object with a different solver and a different instrument.
preregistered_predictions.falsified_if: the fitted slope's 95% interval excludes [0.45, 0.70], or excludes the EV-ICI-001 interval

claims.note: No discrete logarithm is solved and no relation is claimed. The cost model is exact arithmetic on a declared model; the ladder is a timing measurement on real descended systems. Claim tier: model-plus-measurement, scoped to the Gaudry/Diem subspace factor base, to binary fields, and to the declared cost model.
